text: Started in worktree branch worktree-agent-a4cac5af73782c350 (from c8ed714). Survey: Java2D/Canvas already case discs and batched marks via their shared path painter; JavaFX Disc/Circle (oval fast path) and SVG/PDF discs, rects and batched marks drop the casing; batched/single Cross draws casing(h),stroke(h),casing(v) so the second casing overpaints the first bar. Picking ignores casing for paths (CasingPickingSuite pins identical hits), so points will follow the same contract.
